name: CSRD/ESRS regulatory watch — change log
description: Chronological record of regulatory events that affect CSRD/ESRS reporting. Each entry states what changed, its legal status, and which engine artefacts it affects. This is the data foundation of the Regulatory Watch: when a new event is ingested, the engine can diff versions and tell each customer exactly what changed for them.

events.title: CSRD (EU) 2022/2464 adopted
events.summary: Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive replaces the NFRD; phased application from FY2024.

events.title: First set of ESRS adopted
events.summary: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772 — 12 standards (2 cross-cutting, 5 environmental, 4 social, 1 governance).

events.title: Accounting Directive size thresholds updated
events.summary: Size thresholds raised ~25% for inflation: turnover €50M, balance sheet €25M.

events.title: Omnibus I package proposed
events.summary: Proposal to restrict CSRD scope to undertakings >1000 employees, remove listed SMEs, cap value-chain data requests at VSME level. NOT in force — forward planning only.

events.title: 'Stop-the-clock' directive adopted
events.summary: Wave 2 and wave 3 application dates postponed by two years (FY2027 and FY2028 respectively).

events.title: Simplified ESRS adopted
events.summary: Revised ESRS: mandatory datapoints reduced by more than 60%, total datapoints by more than 70%; double materiality retained. Applies after scrutiny and OJ publication.
